newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds may see limited weakness to 102.50.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds may see limited weakness to 102.50.

text.p: LIFFE September Bund futures will be mostly rangebound on Friday with any short term bias pointing to the downside, technical analysts said.

"Bunds are still looking reasonably constructive," said Charles Diebel, senior fixed income strategist at Technical Data in London. "Short term momentum is turning south so we may see a little bit of weakness but if anything the longer term trend is still to the upside."
He said the downside would be limited by support at 102.62 to 50.
At 0709 GMT September Bund futures were down 0.06 at 102.74.
For this session, Diebel said Bunds would struggle to get above 103.02/03, the high formed in the after hours trading session on Thursday.
"The real key level we need to break to turn really bullish is 103.15. Sooner or later we are going to break that but...it looks beyond the pale for today," he said.
An analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in Frankfurt set a narrow range for Friday, saying Bunds were likely to be limited to 102.60 on the downside and 102.90 on the upside.
"We expect light range trading provided there is nothing surprising from the Ifo data or Waigel's speeches," he said.

The German Ifo index of business climate for June is expected at 0800 GMT, while Finance Minister Theo Waigel will address the German government development agency Kreditanstalt fuer Wiederaufbau forum at 0900 GMT.
At the short end, December Euromark futures were trading at 96.66, down one basis point.
